editorial.blurb: Taj Indian Restaurant serves some of the freshest, most luxurious Indian fare around, paired with creative cocktails and genuinely warm hospitality that makes every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the biryanis and samosas—reviewers consistently rave about them—and don't miss their creative cocktails made by a talented bartender; arrive early or be prepared to wait, as the restaurant offers complimentary henna tattoos while you do.

topDishes.note: Described as amazing and among the best reviewers have had
You can't go wrong with any of their biryanis, according to reviews
Authentic and perfectly paired with garlic naan and mango chutney
